2026So Far: The Streak Ends, and the Favorite Takes the Top SeatIn progress · 7 weeks in · dahlilama 11-3, Birdgangflyeagles 11-3, Goldminers1 8-6

Seven weeks in, Birdgangflyeagles finally lost a head-to-head game, dahlilama posted the week's top score to pull level at 11-3 and take first on points, and MayockJr went shopping for Bijan Robinson. The evidence so far.

The perfect start ends

showmeyourtd23 beat Birdgangflyeagles 109.88–96.14, ending Birdgangflyeagles' 6-0 head-to-head start. The streak stops at six, matching his career best from 2023 instead of breaking it. 96.14 was below the week's median, so it was a two-loss week and he slides to 11-3. For showmeyourtd23 it was a two-win week: he's 4-10 and has won two of his last three head-to-head games.

dahlilama takes the top seat

dahlilama beat Goldminers1 122.68–113.12 with the top score of the week. That's two straight head-to-head wins and a 2-0 week, so he's 11-3, level with Birdgangflyeagles and ahead of him on points (886 to 837). He's now the futures favorite at +150, down from +250.

Goldminers1 lost his second straight head-to-head game but scored above the median, so he's 8-6. He still leads the league with 894 points, eight ahead of dahlilama.

MayockJr makes a blockbuster

MayockJr made two trades in Week 7. From giJ03 he got Bijan Robinson and Denzel Boston for A.J. Brown, Bucky Irving and Ollie Gordon II. From Bjspjs4 he got Travis Etienne Jr. for Carnell Tate. Then he beat juleon8 98.36–93.32 and is 5-9. He leads the league with 36 moves.

Bjspjs4 climbs back to .500

Bjspjs4 beat rbanuelos3 111.18–101.42 for his second straight head-to-head win and a 2-0 week. He's 7-7, up from 4-6 two weeks ago. The Etienne deal was his sixth trade of the season, and Carnell Tate has now been part of three of them. No other manager has more than three trades.

Also in the file

  • Sleon1000 beat kevinnguu 106.80–96.52 for his second straight head-to-head win. He's 6-8, up from 4-8, and still has the most points against in the league (842). kevinnguu's three-game head-to-head run ended and he's 7-7.
  • elysianbeer beat giJ03 107.00–93.22 to snap a two-game head-to-head skid. He's 8-6, level with Goldminers1.
  • rbanuelos3 has lost three straight head-to-head and is 6-8.
  • juleon8 fell to 7-7 but still has the fewest points against in the league (646).
  • giJ03 had the week's low score, 93.22, and is 4-10.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 11-3, tied for the best record, and second in the league in points.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 11-3. His 6-0 head-to-head start ended in Week 7, matching his career-best six-game streak. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 6-8 after three straight head-to-head losses.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs. 6-8 this year after two straight head-to-head wins.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also leads the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4, the top score of that week. 8-6 after snapping a two-game head-to-head skid. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-10, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 7-7 with six trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
